title: Understanding Poetry — Who Is the Speaker?
skills: identify the speaker in a poem
distinguish the poetic speaker from the author
analyze how the speaker's perspective shapes tone and meaning
support interpretations of speaker and voice with textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces the poetic speaker as the voice through which a poem is presented and reinforces the distinction between speaker and author. Supports analysis of perspective, voice, tone, persona, and evidence-based interpretation across high school English courses.
